'''The Grill''' was a district of [[Shulell City]] on [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. It was comprised of a mixture of slums and businesses, bazaars and shops. The Grill was a haven for those seeking to escape the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and illegal black market goods could be obtained there. A small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell was located within The Grill.
